background.name: Coastal blue
background.job: Sky behind every diorama, the ocean on the maps, and (as a lighter tint) the humans' service network. Cool = human.

subject.name: Warm cream
subject.job: The world itself: land, plaster buildings, furniture, cream-coloured cats.

accent.name: Terracotta
accent.job: Everything the cats add: territories, rooftop routes, the paw seal, roof tiles, ginger cats. Warm = cat.

highlight.name: Leafy green
highlight.job: Living things: gardens on the freeways, catnip fields, wildlife sanctuaries.

key.name: Gold sunlight
key.job: The key light (late afternoon, about 4,300 K). Where it pools on the map it marks sun estates: the cats' wealth.

evening.name: Kitchen lamp
evening.job: The one lighting change: warm evening interior light for the final kitchen scene.

text.name: Near-black
text.job: Titles, captions, stat numbers, map labels.

secondary.name: Warm grey
secondary.job: Stat labels, asides, 'fictional' tags, legend text.

panelFill.name: Off-white
panelFill.job: Every caption, stats, legend and end-card panel (with an 18 px background blur).

panelEdge.name: Warm grey edge
panelEdge.job: 1.5 px panel outline; the halo behind 3d map labels.
